title: Polish Trout Pilaf
description: A flavorful and nutritious pilaf dish infused with the delicate taste of trout, perfect for a dinner meal.
instructions: Heat butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Add sliced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add Polish sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add pilaf to the skillet and stir to combine with sausage and onion mixture.
Add trout fillet to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
Serve trout on top of pilaf mixture.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes to allow flavors to meld together.
